units.source_text: “绸缎是用眼睛来选购的，光凭嘴巴买货，不正说明没有眼力吗？

en.t: "Silk fabrics are something you choose with your eyes; if you buy goods just by talking, doesn't that show you have no eye for quality?

units.source_text: 商人嘛，看一眼就识货了，尽管我们的廉价货多。”

en.t: A merchant can tell good merchandise at a glance, even though we carry many inexpensive items."
